strictPublicTypes: Passed with ES2024, NodeNext, strict, no emit
storage: Actual native Node SQLite in isolated temporary directories
model: Pi faux provider; no live model requests
verified: Same peer transcript reused after close/reopen with no new model request on reopen
Stable original request IDs and one report per settled answer
Second job queued until first final answer, preserving distinct submissions and answers
Nonzero peer token usage included in the original Harness total
Ordinary abort skips background boundary; full background subtree abort stops tool and report work
Single registry uses each conversation document for role prompt and action scope before and after restart
limitations: No Kada peer UI/API, full role assignment lifecycle, SIGKILL for new peer reporters, live provider comparison or physical-device qualification yet. These remain explicit product acceptance requirements.
